CustomField.description: Not Linked = the document hasn't been attached/referenced yet. Linked = a file is attached via Notes & Attachments/Files and AF_LinkedContentDocumentId__c points at it, or AF_ExternalReference__c holds an external pointer (e.g. an Approval Reference already recorded elsewhere on the reservation). Waived = an admin/manager has explicitly excused this document for this reservation (e.g. Trade-In Appraisal on a deal with no trade-in) - counts as satisfied for the completeness check but is visibly distinct from Linked in reporting.
CustomField.label: Status
